decisions.decision: Build all seven fixes in workshop-plan/tasks.html now. H041: if the last runner history entry is more than 24h old, mark the runner stale and show the latest task log entry with its time. H045: replace every em/en dash empty value with "None". H048: add aria-labels to #nt-* and to #f-area, #f-status and #q. H049: set the due placeholder to "Due (YYYY-MM-DD)". H050: show reviewers on each .kcard. H051: add a plural() helper ("1 item", "2 items"). H052: set STATIC from a published flag (sync_board.py writes a flag or probes tasks/sync.json), use relative upload paths, and keep T-322's direct-save public flow working. Extend probe-tasks.mjs and probe-public-board.mjs to cover these, add a no-dash source check, and run both. Commit to main, publish with sync_board.py, check the live page, mark H041 to H052 fixed with the commit hash in AUDIT.md, then move to review.
decisions.why: T-274 spec and AUDIT.md list every finding with its exact fix. Nothing needs Adi. Under orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09), commits and publishing our own board are allowed. T-322 shares probe-public-board.mjs, so its flow must stay intact.
